Package it.polimi.ingsw.am54

package it.polimi.ingsw.am54
Root of the Mesos project (group AM54), a multiplayer board game developed for the Software Engineering Final Project.

Contains the executable entry points:

  • MainLauncher / Launcher — client startup (GUI or CLI choice);
  • Server — server startup;
  • MainClient — direct startup of the client in textual mode.

The architecture follows the MVC pattern with State Pattern for the game phases, Observer for update propagation and a dual transport layer (TCP Socket and RMI).
